notes.title: Dark Gate 2025
notes.notes:
[h2]🚀 Dark Gate 2025 – New Universe Launch![/h2]
[b]Ready for a new adventure?[/b]
On [b]Friday, April 4th 2025 at 7:00 PM (CEST)[/b], a new round begins in the [i]Dark Gate[/i] universe!

[b]⚙️ Universe Settings:[/b]
[list]  [*][b]Universe Speed:[/b] 4x[/*]  [*][b]Flight Speed:[/b] 3x[/*]  [*][b]Planets:[/b] 9 (+1 purchasable)[/*]  [*][b]Astros:[/b] Max. 2[/*]  [*][b]Scanner:[/b] 1 (with Fleeter Spec 2)[/*][/list]

[b]🌟 Features:[/b]
[list]  [*]Tunnel system & burrowable defenses[/*]  [*]ISB explosion[/*]  [*]New AZ system: Attack from 25% to 400% of your points[/*]  [*]Speedup system for a faster start (up to 500 billion Spice!)[/*][/list]

[b]🔁 Account Transfer After Event:[/b]
After the event, you can transfer your account to [b]RETRO, Nexus, or Sirius[/b] – or secure [b]Spice for your main account[/b]![list]  [*]Resources will be reduced by 80% during full transfer[/*]  [*]Alternative: Transfer 20% of Spice value (limit: 100–200 billion)[/*][/list]

[b]📅 Event Duration:[/b]
[list]  [*][b]Start:[/b] Friday, April 4th 2025 – 7:00 PM (CEST)[/*]  [*][b]End:[/b] Sunday, August 17th 2025 – 10:00 PM (CEST)[/*][/list]

[b]🌌 See you in Dark Gate!
– Your SpaceInvasion Team[/b]
